rules.threshold: train q95 Mahalanobis distance, unclipped evaluation z; no heldout tuning

limitations: reused pilot datasets, not independent final validation; R6 training only; pooled brightness/ISO; residual D is not marginal single-frame noise; post-development peak-amplitude injection differs from RMS contamination campaign; no filtering or profile calibration measured
units: dimensionless scores normalised to their own training threshold, compatible <=1
